description: Every LLM provider transport (Anthropic Messages, OpenAI chat completions, Ollama / vLLM / OpenAI-compatible) lives in the one completion module, bin/lib/anthropic.ts: request bodies, provider headers, stop-reason handling, streaming, the session cost cap and the SESSION.log llm record. No other shipped module names a provider API path or provider header; call complete() / probeLlmEndpoint() instead. The same module is the only caller of the http.ts LLM egress allowlist: the `llm: { endpoint }` fetch option lets a request reach the configured model endpoint's origin (loopback over http, a private address over https) past the source-host SSRF guard, and http.ts takes that origin from its caller — so a fetch() that passes `llm` anywhere else could allowlist its own internal target. (Renaming the module renames this row, but it stays one module.)
